core_obligations: Construct the common transversal pseudocircle without losing the digon structure.
Draw the bipartite double cover and retain the complete independent-edge crossing parity analysis.
Apply the Strong Hanani-Tutte theorem and count the doubled edges to obtain the tight bound.
difficulty_reason: The proof combines a common transversal construction with a bipartite graph double cover. Its independent-edge parity analysis requires several cyclic orders and curve-redrawing cases, all retained with the original figures, before using Hanani-Tutte planarity to derive the extremal bound.
